pairwise_source_policy: QQP and PAWS/PAWS-X labels identify paraphrase or contrast pairs, not standalone SOP gold; no pair is converted without independent canonical semantic mapping, source-rights review and grouped split.

evidence.finding: Mirror frontmatter says mit, but Licensing Information says [Needs More Information]; source_datasets names squad, race, newsqa, qamr and movieQA.
Original QA2D code repository MIT grant calls covered work 'Software'; does not demonstrate rights in third-party question/answer texts and crowdsourced declarative transformations.
Stanford expressly distributes its own SQuAD data under CC BY-SA 4.0; this covers the standalone SQuAD source scaffold, not the unreviewed QA2D mixture or all its added annotations.

notes: No QA2D rows have been exported as ChatSOP gold. SQuAD input rights do not establish rights over every QA2D component.
Even an admissible QA2D question/answer/declarative triple cannot safely be mapped to arbitrary SOP predicates without independent semantic adjudication.
Preserve (dataset, example_uid), not example_uid alone, as the source item key.

evidence.finding: Official release 214185889 bytes, Last-Modified 2021-10-06; ZIP central directory lists 132 entries, README.md sole documentation entry, no LICENSE or NOTICE. README has no license grant; it specifies OWA '~' negative rule conditions are hard negation, whereas CWA uses negation-as-failure.
Structured mirror expressly requires confirming upstream data license before downstream redistribution; its OWA/CWA mapping is not an independent license grant.
RuleTaker repository has Apache-2.0 LICENSE for that repository; no proof that a separately released ProofWriter dataset inherits this license.
Ai2 guidelines cover Ai2 datasets but are not a dataset-specific redistribution license.

notes: No ProofWriter corpus theory rows or derived SOP examples are committed; cached official README is metadata and contains its own illustrative sample. Probe operates in-memory; exporter is gated pending upstream rights.
The official README distinguishes OWA explicit hard negation from CWA negation-as-failure. Never silently convert CWA negative unknowns into false.
Only formal typed structured OWA theories can be deterministically mapped; provenance retains theory ID, question ID, source SHA, exact upstream texts and proof fields.
Standalone official SQuAD v2 dev source, not a QA2D sample. Limit 24 initial raw passage/question/answer-span scaffolds; no SOP target or SOP gold labels, and no model selection on these dev answers.
CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution/sharealike obligations remain applicable; do not mix with differently licensed QA2D annotations without review.
